set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Flagship results expose converged, status, iterations, stopping residual, and mass/marginal residuals.
- Iteration-limit exit is distinct from convergence.
- Numerical breakdown cannot be reported as success.
- Nested solvers distinguish inner from outer convergence.
- Tests force success, max-iteration, and numerical-failure paths.
set.title: Standardize convergence, residual, and solver-status diagnostics
